name: Jain Juushinden JEVALD
source:
While returning home from his crappy job, our guy found a girl at the end of a bolt of lightning. It seems she has chased a mad scientist from her planet to earth. She needs his help to stop the mad scientist from collecting earth female energy. How does he do that? Well, a little mad scientist drug does wonders.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公结束糟糕的工作、踏上归途时，在一道闪电的尽头发现了一个女孩。她似乎从自己的星球一路追到地球，追捕一名疯狂科学家。她需要他的帮助，阻止那名科学家收集地球女性的能量。该怎么做？只要用上一点疯狂科学家的药物，效果就出奇地好。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
